name: list-constructor-spread-operator-test-ae223889d2/inference-negative-e.bal
spec_references: Expressions: Mapping constructor restriction: "Currently [spread-field](https://ballerina.io/spec/lang/master/#spread-field) not supported"
reason: The case checks list-spread inference for arrays and tuples, including aliases, unions, readonly contexts and never rest members, and rejection of undefined references, non-list spread operands and incompatible assignments. List constructors and local declarations are supported without a list-spread restriction. The explicit spread exclusion applies to mapping constructors, not these lists. These negative type-checking assertions remain within the supported grammar and type system.
test_design_notes: This is a compile-negative case with both expected-error and expected-success statements; the success statements also exercise inferred list types through incompatible scalar assignments.
The final typedesc declarations exercise rejection of undefined and non-list spread operands; illegal operands alone do not make the case a feature request.
